purpose: Separate first-observation/association calculation from owner callbacks in the shared legacy/checkpoint replay path.
change: New data-only derivation returns a refusal reason or detached observation/association. Caller retains conditional first-only identity hashing, accumulator ownership, event/page admission, ordered version processing and failure propagation.
rosters: Baseline88 original page/intake/capture/memo methods. Candidate same88 plus8 new derivation and real hash-order controls. These are different explicitly declared rosters, not a failed-baseline bug repair.

contract.domain: Private internal helper; ordinary already-admitted scalar observation/admission records. Not an arbitrary-object decoder or authority boundary.
contract.state: Does not mutate row, candidate or prior. Returns detached scalar observation and admission records. Caller owns and updates private replay accumulators.
contract.identity: Caller keys prior by exact source/event pair and hashes only first occurrences. No sorting or deduplication of the association stream.
contract.repeat: Semantic mismatch returns original refusal reason and no update. Valid repeat retains first observation identity/version/time and current admission.
contract.failure: Missing first candidate returns typed reason and no partial result. Existing caller maps reasons through original refusal path. Discard private accumulators on failure.
contract.resources: Original input/output reservation and replay limits remain in caller. New helper has no loop and fixed caller-supplied fields; Python allocation and whole-job bounds are not formally established.
